audience: sales teams that run their pipeline and follow-ups in PipeRun CRM

useCases.title: Find deals that have gone quiet
useCases.text: List the pipelines, then the open deals of one pipeline, and read the activities of each deal. Spot the deals with no recent follow-up.

useCases.title: Plan a follow-up call for a deal
useCases.text: List the team users to find an owner id, then create a call linked to the deal with a due date.

useCases.title: Move a deal to another stage
useCases.text: List the stages of a pipeline, then move the deal to the right stage or change its value.

useCases.title: Add a new company, contact and deal
useCases.text: Create the company and the person, then open a deal for them in a pipeline stage.

useCases.title: Read the notes on a deal
useCases.text: Read the notes written on a deal and the contact person behind it, before a call.
